data.name: greenSand
data.description: greenSand is a Netherlands-based enhanced rock weathering supplier in Enkhuizen, led by Eddy Wijnker, that accelerates natural olivine weathering to permanently capture atmospheric CO2. The company distributes olivine for construction, landscaping and agricultural applications, and issues ONCRA-certified CO2 removal certificates. In late 2025 it launched greenSand Japan to expand its ERW method into Asia.
